cases.sentence: ___ и первой земли уже не было, моря тоже больше не было.
cases.explain: «Первого неба» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.

cases.sentence: Первого неба и ___ уже не было, моря тоже больше не было.
cases.explain: «первой земли» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.

cases.explain: «святой город» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

cases.sentence: И я услышал ___, прозвучавший от трона:
cases.explain: «громкий голос» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people, and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.

cases.sentence: Один из ангелов, имеющих семь чаш, наполненных семью ___, подошел и сказал мне:
cases.explain: «последними бедствиями» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls, who were loaded with the seven last plagues came, and he spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the wife, the Lamb’s bride.”

cases.sentence: Оттуда он показал мне ___ Иерусалим, спускающийся с небес от Бога .
cases.explain: «святой город» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,

cases.sentence: Ангел измерил стены, они были толщиной в сто сорок четыре локтя , согласно ___, которыми пользовался ангел.
cases.explain: «человеческим меркам» — after the preposition «согласно», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.

cases.sentence: Стена была построена из яшмы, а ___ — из чистого, как прозрачное стекло, золота.
cases.explain: «сам город» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.

cases.sentence: Стена была построена из яшмы, а сам город — из чистого, как ___, золота.
cases.explain: «прозрачное стекло» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.

cases.sentence: Двенадцать ворот были двенадцатью жемчужинами: каждые ворота из ___ .
cases.explain: «отдельной жемчужины» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

cases.sentence: А ___ города была из чистого, как прозрачное стекло, золота.
cases.explain: «центральная улица» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

cases.sentence: А центральная улица города была из чистого, как ___, золота.
cases.explain: «прозрачное стекло» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
